governance.ceo_title: President and Chief Executive Officer (Chair of the Board of Management)
governance.ceo_total_comp_note: NL optional (no SCT equivalent): 2024 Remuneration Report total ~EUR 6.97M (~$7.5M) — base EUR 1.25M, performance bonus, performance shares, pension, other. Two-tier board: Board of Management + Supervisory Board (no US-style SCT obligation).
governance.source: Philips Annual Report 2024 & Remuneration Report 2024 (philips.com/c-dam); AGM 2025 press releases; Dutch Corporate Governance Code (Supervisory Board fully independent of Management Board)
